sn11.16:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || || Atha kho Sakko devānam indo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi ||
sn11.16:2.1: Yajamānānaṃ manussānam || puññapekhānapāṇinaṃ || karotam opadhikaṃ puññaṃ || kattha dinnam mahapphalan ti || ||
sn11.16:3.1: Cattāro ca paṭipannā || cattāro ca phale ṭhitā || esa saṅgho ujubhūto || paññāsīlasamāhito || ||
sn11.16:4.1: yajamānānam manussānam || puññapekhānapāṇinam || karotam opadhikaṃ puññaṃ || saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti || ||
